question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

5 11 17 ? 29 35
solution:
**Logic :** (6) is added to each number subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f72f0c1dd689bf795046ea72ec78fc6b80ee4e721fa325589cb4b12c7e4dd99.png] 

Hence, **"23"** is the correct answer.
